name: shiksha-student-teacher-tutorial
title: Learning and teaching, side by side

chapters.caption: 01  Two separate accounts: the learner opens a course while the teacher views the class.
02  The learner asks a question; the teacher opens Insights and scopes it to that learner.
03  While the course answer arrives, the teacher asks about the learner's current activity.
04  The learner opens the check, chooses an answer and explains the reasoning.
05  The teacher asks what changed; the response uses the submitted demo attempt.
06  Both views remain visible: learner feedback and a scoped teaching next step.

description: Two simultaneous actual UI views: a learner completes a concept check while a teacher queries the Insights agent about that same demo activity.
capture: Separate student and teacher browser contexts captured together at every frame; both use the real React frontend.
timing: Frames are paced for clarity, not a performance or real-time telemetry benchmark.
isolation: Synthetic accounts and local shared fixtures only. Teacher replies are composed from the learner's actual intercepted demo messages and submitted quiz receipt, not live cloud inference.
